repository.comparison_scope: Merged local-quantitative-refinements sources 01–10; the separately archived moment and weighted-spectrum reports; relevant paper and Lean source files. This is a bounded source comparison, not an exhaustive priority determination.

status.manuscript: Unrefereed research article with complete mathematical arguments and exact finite certificates.
status.formalization: No new Lean formalization or proof-assistant certification is claimed.
status.global_szemeredi_bound: No improved global quantitative Szemeredi bound is claimed.
status.source_archives: Referenced source archives are not redistributed in this package.
status.verification_scope: Finite programs verify specified identities, matrices and exhaustive finite certificates. Universal positivity, all-group inequalities and asymptotic statements are proved in the article rather than inferred from finite testing.
integrator_notes: Preserve the distinction between h(p), the onset of full-support prime torsion; h_cyc(m), the minimum support for an exact cyclic quotient of order m; and h_pos(m), which additionally requires universal nonnegativity of the real centered moment.
The minimum-rank theorem concerns Smith torsion, not every characteristic-dependent cancellation.

The transport appendix is formulated in a general finite-fibre model. Its arbitrary-kappa threshold is not asserted at the original prime-order Gowers interface without the model's transport hypotheses.
Displayed numerical crossing values in higher dimensions supplement exact implicit definitions; the 2/3 fourth-norm bound has a rational certificate.

manuscript.title: Further Quantitative Refinements of Gowers's Szemeredi Argument
manuscript.subtitle: Higher norm comparisons, joint quadratic rigidity, and restriction by affine rank

incoming_archives.role: Prior central-binomial Fourier-moment inequality and pair-mass stability; in particular c_4^odd <= (8/35)^(1/4). Poses the higher-norm sharp-constant and single-pair-extremality questions addressed in part by the present article.
incoming_archives.overlap_boundary: The generic moment baseline is credited to this manuscript. The present resonance/dual coupling yields 2/3, and the explicit two-harmonic example disproves global single-pair extremality.

manuscript.title: Weighted Derivative Spectra and Sharp Local Rigidity in Gowers' Argument

incoming_archives.role: Overlap check for weighted derivative spectra, local U^3/L^2 rigidity, and Freiman restriction.
incoming_archives.overlap_boundary: Its critical U^3/L^2 profile is distinct from the real centered U^2/U^4 gap proved here. No claim of a full audit of every theorem in the archive is made.

literature.title: A new proof of Szemeredi's theorem
literature.role: Foundational proof and local cube/transport interfaces.

literature.title: Anti-Hadamard Matrices, Coin Weighing, Threshold Gates, and Indecomposable Hypergraphs
literature.journal: Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A
literature.theorem_locator: Section 2.4, pages 9–11 of the author PDF: unimodular zero-one anti-Hadamard construction; the closing remark confirms absolute determinant one.
literature.role: Deep external input for large inverse entries in unimodular Boolean matrices; the subsequent encoding, composition, cyclic-cokernel and parameter arguments are proved in the article.

literature.title: Determinants of binary matrices achieve every integral value up to Ω(2^n/n)
literature.role: Earlier consecutive binary-determinant range; context for support-efficient realization. Not the deep input for the final sharp leading asymptotic.

literature.title: The range of 0–1 determinants is large
literature.publication_status: Preprint; no peer-reviewed publication status is asserted.
literature.role: Direct construction antecedent. The stated range has logarithm (1/2)n log n - 7n log log n. The present article rebuilds the determinant identities with explicit ceiling and sign conventions, retains a unit cofactor, and improves the range to (1/2)n log n - n log log n - 4n, with a further linear-loss refinement.

claim_ledger.statement: h(p) = D_div(p)+1; the same onset controls minimum rational augmented rank for p-primary Smith torsion in arbitrary Boolean supports, and the minimum ambient cube dimension is h(p)-1.
claim_ledger.comparison: Strengthens the prior support-lattice formulation and all-prime existence in merged source 09 by an exact equivalence with divisibility of Boolean determinants.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Integral row/column operations, rational rank, and dimension-minimal modular kernels.

claim_ledger.statement: A Boolean matrix of order n with cyclic cokernel Z/m gives an affinely independent Boolean support of at most n+1 vertices with faithful full-support coordinates and row-lattice quotient Z/m.
claim_ledger.comparison: Separates isolated cyclic realization from general p-torsion and allows determinant-range results to transfer to h_cyc.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Augment by a zero vertex, identify the cyclic coordinate homomorphism, and delete zero-image columns while retaining all projected Boolean rows.
claim_ledger.limitation: No equality h(p)=h_cyc(p) is asserted for every prime.

claim_ledger.statement: h(7)=7 and h(11)=h(13)=h(17)=8, with isolated cyclic realizations at those sizes.
claim_ledger.status: Proved by mathematical reductions and exact finite certificates
claim_ledger.comparison: Extends the prior values h(2)=4, h(3)=5, h(5)=6.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Explicit determinant-p matrices, Hadamard-type size restrictions, and exhaustive residue-orbit nonexistence certificates where required.

claim_ledger.statement: For all sufficiently large n, every positive q <= floor exp((1/2)n log n - n log log n - 4n) is the determinant of a Boolean matrix of order n with a unit cofactor and cyclic cokernel.
claim_ledger.status: Proved in the article using published Alon–Vu input
claim_ledger.comparison: Rebuilds and strengthens the 2025 Shitov determinant-range construction; the construction's antecedents are explicitly credited.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Exact Schur complements, signed binary row encoding, unimodular elimination, and asymptotic parameter bounds.
claim_ledger.verification_limitation: The finite regression suite does not prove the eventual range theorem.

claim_ledger.statement: Any constant C_*+epsilon with epsilon>0 can replace 4 in the eventual range, where C_*=2 log 2 +(1/2)log(3/(2 log 2)) +1/2.
claim_ledger.comparison: Further parameter refinement of the same construction; no optimality claim for C_*.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Ceiling/floor cost control and asymptotic optimization of the block size.

claim_ledger.statement: h_cyc(m) is asymptotic to 2 log m / log log m as m tends through all integers, and h(p) has the same leading asymptotic as p tends through primes.
claim_ledger.comparison: Resolves the leading support-growth question from the prior isolated-torsion framework and extends exact cyclic realization to every modulus.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Hadamard lower bound, Lambert-W inversion, and cyclic determinant construction.
claim_ledger.limitation: The exact second-order coefficient remains open.

claim_ledger.statement: Every cyclic modulus q>=2 admits an explicit positive Fourier detector on 2 ceil(log2 q)+2 Boolean vertices with row-lattice quotient Z/q.
claim_ledger.comparison: Elementary support-efficient positive realization, separate from the asymptotically optimal construction. It also attains the first seven positive support minima.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Binary addition-chain relations and an exact character-kernel product identity.

claim_ledger.statement: For an affinely independent Boolean configuration with exact cyclic quotient Z/m and faithful full-support coordinates c, its moment is nonnegative for every finite abelian group and every real centered function if and only if the multiset of c coordinates splits into inverse pairs. The criterion is already forced by testing the group Z/m.
claim_ledger.status: Proved in the article for every m>=2, including composite and even moduli
claim_ledger.comparison: A necessary-and-sufficient structural condition for the positive cyclic detector framework; no exhaustive literature priority claim is made.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Inverse-pair Fourier factorization for sufficiency; weighted Fourier amplitudes select the unit orbit, whose nontrivial phase characters have mean zero when pairing fails.
claim_ledger.limitation: Faithfulness and the absence of zero coordinates are hypotheses. A nonzero self-inverse coordinate must have even multiplicity.

claim_ledger.statement: h_pos(m) is asymptotic to 4 log m / log log m, and h_pos(m)/h_cyc(m) tends to 2, as m tends through all integers.
claim_ledger.comparison: Determines the exact leading asymptotic cost of universal positivity for cyclic Boolean configurations.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Inverse pairing forces s=2t and a full-rank ternary projected matrix with determinant divisible by m, giving m<=t^(t/2). Doubling a full-support cyclic presentation gives the matching upper bound.
claim_ledger.limitation: The exact second-order term and most individual values remain open.

claim_ledger.statement: h_pos(2), h_pos(3), h_pos(4), h_pos(5), h_pos(6), h_pos(7), h_pos(8) are respectively 4, 6, 6, 8, 8, 8, 8.
claim_ledger.comparison: Exact first values of the newly separated positive-support parameter.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: The ternary determinant maxima in orders one, two and three are 1, 2 and 4; the elementary cyclic detector attains every resulting lower bound.
claim_ledger.verification_limitation: The program checks the constructive examples. The ternary determinant lower obstruction is proved in the article.

claim_ledger.statement: For every finite abelian odd-order group and every real centered f, ||f||_(U^2)^4 <= (2/3)||f||_(U^4)^4; monotonicity extends this to every d>=4.
claim_ledger.comparison: Improves the incoming moment manuscript's bound (8/35)^(1/4). The prior central-binomial moment inequality is credited, not claimed anew.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Dominant-pair moment profile, exact fourth dual function, positive third- and fifth-harmonic resonances, and rational case bounds including character order three.

claim_ledger.statement: On Z/29, f=chi+chi^(-1)-(chi^3+chi^(-3))/7 has fourth-power norm ratio 4804/5465198316262956^(1/4), exceeding every single-pair ratio.
claim_ledger.comparison: Disproves global single-pair extremality in the fourth-norm question posed in the incoming moment report.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Exact finite Fourier polynomial and the single-pair formulas, including the exceptional order-three case.
claim_ledger.limitation: Does not determine the sharp value c_4^odd.

claim_ledger.statement: The exact balanced-multinomial pair profile combined with the fourth dual certificate yields improved implicit upper bounds for the corresponding fourth-power norm ratios in dimensions five through eight.
claim_ledger.comparison: Refines the generic central-binomial moment estimate from the incoming moment report.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: A multinomial-square inequality, monotonicity of a polynomial in p(1-p), and uniquely defined profile crossings.
claim_ledger.limitation: Displayed decimals supplement exact implicit bounds; no sharpness or further gain in all higher dimensions is claimed.

claim_ledger.statement: The defect threshold 1/[2+(2k-2)kappa] is sharp in the stated general finite-fibre transport model.
claim_ledger.comparison: Refines the transport-sensitive local rigidity framework in merged source 07.
claim_ledger.proof_kind: Transport bounds, a coupled-path argument, and an explicit finite-model sharpness construction.
claim_ledger.limitation: No arbitrary-kappa replacement at the original prime-order interface follows without establishing the model's transport hypotheses.

norm_checks: Two-harmonic polynomial and exact lower bound

verification.proof_boundary: Small-prime exclusions use complete finite search-space certificates. Large-parameter and all-group statements have mathematical proofs in the article. Finite examples alone are not asserted to establish them.
